Each school should reasonably arrange its budget; implement legal and regulatory requirements, improve the work mechanism and regulatory system for network data security, and enhance emergency response and security capabilities. Establish a service filing and review mechanism, strengthen technical supervision and ethical governance; incorporate artificial intelligence education into regular teaching and quality assessment, conduct monitoring and evaluation, organize achievement exchanges, and promote advanced experiences. (Responsible units: Provincial Department of Education, Provincial Department of Science and Technology, Provincial Data Bureau, Zhejiang University)
